name: Mezen wood painting
summary: Mezen wood painting (Russian: Мезенская роспись по дереву) or Palashchelskaya painting (Russian: палащельская роспись) is a type of decorative painting applied to household items (spinning wheels, ladles, boxes, bratinas), which developed by the end of the 19th century in the lower basin of the Mezen River.
description: Mezen wood painting (Russian: Мезенская роспись по дереву) or Palashchelskaya painting (Russian: палащельская роспись) is a type of decorative painting applied to household items (spinning wheels, ladles, boxes, bratinas), which developed by the end of the 19th century in the lower basin of the Mezen River. The oldest dated spinning wheel with Mezen painting is from 1815, although pictorial motifs of this style appear in handwritten books from the 18th century produced in the Mezen region.
